reference_system.description: What truth was compared against: marker mocap lab, MRI landmarks, tape measures, dynamometer...

kinematics_rmse_deg.description: RMSE per joint per plane — planes reported separately, never averaged away.

gates.description: Each docs/accuracy.md acceptance target: pass/fail as measured on this setup.

synthetic.description: True for software round-trip tests against synthetic truth. A synthetic report never approves any use.

reference_grade.description: What the reference is. Only marker-mocap references can approve a use; markerless references give agreement, not accuracy.

feedback_allowed_joint_planes.description: joint.plane pairs that passed their gate; only these may be used by feedback rules

approved_for.description: What this validation licenses the system to do. exo-assistance requires all gates pass.
